solves.reason: (A) extensive - sciences make extensive use of idealizations. (B) simplifying - makes simplifying assumptions. (C) useful - gas law is useful.
(A) accurate - precisely accurate only under conditions. (B) descriptive - theories are still meant to be descriptive. (C) constraints - constraints as to how idealized.
(A) realized - conditions never entirely realized. (B) predictions - used to make predictions. (C) acceptable - acceptable degrees of accuracy.
② ignore replaces attract. Original: molecules do not attract or repel. ignore is not a type of molecular interaction.
③ contradictions replaces predictions. Original: used to make predictions. contradictions is the opposite of the theory's purpose.
④ valuable replaces worthless. Original: cannot be so far removed as to be worthless. valuable is the opposite.
The sciences do make extensive use of ____. The entire passage is about idealizations in science, starting with this topic sentence.
There are, accordingly, ____ as to how idealized they can be. Constraints = limitations on how far idealization can go.
The theories are still meant to be ____. Next sentence says they are used to make predictions and offer explanations, confirming descriptive purpose.
extensive = widespread (broad in scope). Not intensive (depth/concentration), not exclusive (limited), not tentative (uncertain).
obtain here means 'to be established/prevail' (conditions that never perfectly obtain = conditions that never fully hold). Not acquire (common meaning but wrong context).
regarded = considered. They are best regarded as models = best considered as models.
simplifying opposite = elaborating (making more complex/detailed). clarifying and reducing are similar to simplifying.
worthless opposite = invaluable (extremely valuable). accurate/theoretical/removed are different semantic axes.
(A) at issue = 문제가 되는 (noun, topic/matter). (B) issue a statement = 발행하다 (verb, to publish/release).
a limitation or restriction on what can be done = constraint. Not assumption (something taken for granted), phenomenon (observable event), or idealization (making ideal).
conditions that are never entirely ____ (real) → realized. Be + past participle for passive: conditions are realized. Means 'brought into being/achieved'.
meant to be ____ (describe) → descriptive. Be + adjective as complement. Not description (noun). Descriptive = serving to describe.
their behavior is nonetheless ____. Despite real gases being different, they are close enough to ideal ones that the gas law is useful. 'nonetheless' signals contrast recovery.

They cannot be ____ with acceptable degrees of accuracy. They cannot be so far removed from real world systems as to be worthless. The sentence structure requires 'so far removed...as to be worthless'.
